notes: encoding::pem: Textual blocks, sorted headers, first-valid-block/remainder decoding and opt-in budgets; Block metadata is UTF-8, RawBlock/decode_raw carries Go's arbitrary bytes, differential-checked by tools/pem_check.py

Decode.note: RawBlock holds the type and headers as bytes, which is what Go's strings hold; decode is the String form and skips a block whose type or headers are not UTF-8. Neither applies resource limits, as Go; Limits is opt-in via decode_with_limits

EncodeToMemory.note: Returns Err(EncodeError) where Go returns nil for invalid headers
